mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your ADU project, look for one with specific experience in ADU construction. Verify their licensing and insurance. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolio of completed projects. A good contractor should provide a detailed, transparent proposal, communicate clearly, and have a strong understanding of local zoning and building codes. Prioritize those who offer comprehensive services from design through construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU experience, verify their license and insurance, check references, review their portfolio, and ensure clear communication and detailed proposals.
